node.textContent: Now click File bug. Only now does the server write the issue and copy the held capture — the scrubbed HAR and the session replay — into its artifacts folder.
↳ Click the highlighted control to continue.

Done. The toast shows the filed path — issues/bugs/<id>.md — backed by a sibling <id>.artifacts/ folder holding the scrubbed HAR and the session replay. A reviewed, reproducible, secret-free bug report.
